script_text: Stop scrolling! Pisces, the cosmos ignites with The Moon Major Arcana lighting your inner tides. Overall, this month offers profound growth if you balance ambition with caution, letting the Star’s hope guide your heart. Embrace the celestial rhythm and let love flow freely.
